title: Accessing the highlighted results
body:
Hi

Is it possible to access the highlighted result using instantsearch? I want to show what was found as I'm not necessarily displaying all the information.

Thanks

Joe

comments.body:
@mojosef Yes you can access it in hit your template with `{{{_highlightResult.name.value}}}` for example.

Is that what you are looking for?
I am not sure to get your usecase, what are you trying to achieve in term of user interface?

I maybe display 3 items out of my object but the search is set up for maybe 10 items in the object. I'd like to display on the result hits what triggered the result?

I hope that makes sense
Can you inline an example simplified _highlightResult object that you got and how would you want to display it ultimately. So that I can better understand what you are trying to filter.
Thank you so much, you are definitely my fave person at the minute haha

@vvo Hey, trying to do this in the same way (Kind of) I don't understand what you're doing with the item.matchedData, I'd like to ideally just have each hit list kind of like this - I store certain things in arrays (I have Acting Credits and in it might be `'actingcredits' = ['The Incredible Hulk, Co-Star, Michael Whocares, Film', 'Next Move Credit Whatever']` I'd like to display the matched items as in searching for Hulk might bring out `'{{name}}: The Incredible _Hulk_, Co-Star, Michael Whocares, Film'` Can I modify your code to allow that?
Hi @IAmDragon, can you open a new issue describing your problem in full length? This one was closed and might be hard to discuss here. Thanks!
